composers_checked.name: Young, William
composers_checked.note: Gap check against the Eckert (CPO) and Art d'Echo (Querstand) programmes and the Viola da Gamba Network: added the three Durham sonatas for violin, bass viol and continuo. Not added: pieces for one or two bass viols (duos, solos), lyra-viol pieces, Art d'Echo's "Sonata 29 à 2" (not matched to the three)

composers_checked.name: Dornel, Antoine
composers_checked.note: Gap check against the Musica Barocca (Naxos) and Reyne programmes and the MusicWeb review of Op. 1: added the six Suites en trio and the Sonate en quatuor of the Livre de simphonies, Op. 1 (1709), not on IMSLP. A "Sonate en quatuor" on Ensemble Diderot's Sonatas for Three Violins (Audax, 2021) is not identified (Op. 1 or Op. 3 No. 7)

composers_checked.name: Besozzi, Alessandro
composers_checked.note: Gap check against the Tactus and Ferrarini discs: added Trios Nos. 2–6 (oboe, violin and bass), not on IMSLP. Keys of Nos. 2–6 from the Ferrarini flute version. The 12 Trios for two flutes (IMSLP) have no string part

composers_checked.name: Bertali, Antonio
composers_checked.note: Gap check against the A.C.R.O.N.Y.M. Paradise source list: added two Partiturbuch Ludwig sonatas (à 5 in G minor, à 6 in E minor); its Sonata à 2 in D minor (No. 51) is listed under Young (Durham Sonata 21, attribution disputed). Not added (scoring or source unconfirmed): Kroměříž A 515 sonatas à 6, the sonatas à 8, the Freiburger "Sonatellas". The Prothimia suavissima recording (Ars Antiqua Austria) is of Book 2, mostly by Capricornus, Schmelzer and Pohle

composers_checked.name: Tessarini, Carlo
composers_checked.note: Gap check against Apple Music and MusicBrainz: the recorded Sinfonie Op. 20 (D major, D minor) not added, scoring unconfirmed. Op. 9 keys not confirmed: neither IMSLP nor the Brilliant booklet names them, so the titles carry none

composers_checked.name: Porpora, Nicola Antonio
composers_checked.note: Gap check against Apple Music: Porpora's other chamber works found are duos (12 violin sonatas, cello sonatas) or concertos; a Sonata in D major for violin, cello and continuo (Batzdorfer Hofkapelle, Dresden Pisendel collection) and a Trio in D major (Ensemble Animantica) not added, composer and scoring unconfirmed

note: Open points for the owner: (1) Tessarini's Introduzioni Op. 11 and Contrasto armonico Op. 10 skipped as orchestral; their only recordings are by a chamber orchestra. (2) Bertali: IMSLP's "recorded" pages were matched to recordings through the A.C.R.O.N.Y.M. booklet's manuscript shelfmarks; violone parts counted as their own part where the title counts them (à 4, à 6). (3) Besozzi's Walsh trio-sonata sets: no recording identified. (4) Porpora's six sonatas for violin, cello and continuo are a joint Porpora/Costanzi print, kept under Porpora as IMSLP files them. (5) Young's Durham sonatas à 2 and Eckert's "3 Sonatas" not added; scoring unconfirmed.
